text:
ashley: quick alert  ap-north-eu (eu-north1) local NVMe cohort is spiking metadata write errors and GPU attach latencies are climbing. Seeing attach retries and some pod backpressure.
sam: which nodes?
ashley: hot nodes: gnode-204, gnode-217, gnode-223. sample kernel log: 
```
[ 9876.543210] nvme2: metadata write err -EIO remap_index=0x3f2
[ 9876.543678] nvme2: remap table resize triggered, growth=4x
[ 9876.544001] block: writeback stall detected
```
lucy: yikes. does this line up with janitor schedule? we rolled the cleaner window last week.
raj: confirmed. janitor-runner config pushed 2026-03-20 01:00 UTC increased parallelism for eu-north1. logs show concurrent scrub jobs on multiple devices.
ashley: immediate mitigation options: 1) throttle janitor parallelism to 1 for eu-north1, 2) mark top 5 nodes as scrub-paused, 3) pause aggressive KV compaction for 30m, 4) if needed, shift low-priority GPU jobs to ru-west as temporary failover.
sam: prefer minimal blast radius: do 1+2+3 first. cost note for cross-region fallback: ~ $900/day in egress + preemptible churn if we move active attach flows. ops-lead: acknowledge cost.
raj: patching configmap now: `kubectl -n infra patch configmap janitor-runner -p '{"data":{"eu-north1.parallelism":"1"}}'` then rolling restart of runner daemonset.
lucy: I'll annotate nodes to pause scrubs: `kubectl annotate node gnode-204 warehouse.redwood/scrub-paused=true` for top5. doing gnode-204/217/223/230/242.
sre-bot: ALERT eu-north1 nvme.meta_write_errors > 500/m across cohort - incident=INC-20260323-0789
ashley: also toggling KV COMPACTION backoff: feature-flag set to `kv_compaction.backoff=30m` in ops-flags. pushing now.
sam: monitoring attach latencies. current spike: 2-3x baseline, some 30s+ attach attempts showing retries.
(4m later) lucy: remap growth rate down ~60%, attach SLOs trending back to normal.
ashley: good. raj please open a follow-up RFC on scrub-scheduling heuristics and a mitigation knob for remap-growth rate limiting. call it RFC-2026-storage-scrub-safety.
raj: will do. also filing STORAGE-812 to track potential firmware correlation - these nodes got controller fw 2026-03-17.
ops-lead: notify Dedicated customers in eu-north1 about degraded attach window. ops on-call to coordinate.
sam: timeline: applied throttles at +2m, node annotations +4m, compaction backoff +6m. recommend hold for 1.5h before reverting.
ashley: agreed. we'll keep the scrub concurrency low and run a canary re-enable at 1h. if we see remap bounce again escalate to firmware rollback plan.
sre-bot: RESOLVE incident=INC-20260323-0789 when meta_write_errors < 50/m for 30m
ashley: thanks team. please paste any postmortem notes here after the 2h observation window. closing thread when stable. :white_check_mark:
